pull.title: [RFC] refactor: fix and then enforce param naming via `clang-tidy`
pull.body:
Declarations and definitions tend to drift apart. We could align these, and then enforce that via `clang-tidy`s `readability-inconsistent-declaration-parameter-name` check: https://clang.llvm.org/extra/clang-tidy/checks/readability/inconsistent-declaration-parameter-name.html. 

This may not be worth the (initial) churn / we may also be fine with inconsistency here. Also need to decide which side to align on in some cases.

Currently drafted, as it's based on changes from #36743 to avoid changing could-be-deleted lines twice.
